searchText: It's mainly hard cause we deprecated tooling. But we'll try out just setting ttd to 0 but bellatrix at an epoch, that should work and is an easy hack. I don't see an issue if EL is verifying monotonicity of withdrawal index unless it is planned to stop enforcing this property in the future which I guess is not the case. EL just shouldn't do this, because this job would be redundant <dannyryan> some ELs verifying and some not verifying can lead to *worse* consensus issues in the event that there is an unexpected CL bug <dannyryan> I would force them not to verify via a test <dannyryan> I think it is strictly safer agreed
